findings.note: NHL.com's projected lines for Oct. 17 had Roslovic on Toronto's top line with Auston Matthews and William Nylander, which gives him more chances at assists. This is from the previous game, not a confirmed lineup for tonight against the Sharks.

ESPN shows 3 goals and 3 assists in 9 games this season, averaging 16:47 of ice time, with only one power-play assist. His game log has 1 assist in his last 5 games and none in the Oct. 17 loss to the Islanders, though ESPN's summary still describes him as at home on the top line.
NHL.com's preview named Roslovic a fantasy sleeper who could set career highs and listed him on Matthews' line. He had 15 assists in 69 games for Edmonton last season.
